svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Mockup 01: three directions for Moments, the same moment in each
svg.text: 01 · Three directions, one moment: 21:15, the grand final starts while the crew announces that the pizza is here
Queued: Grand final starting (rank 60) · waits 60 s
Refused: hot game banner (rank 50) · retry in 30 s
A · Conductor: one queue, the legacy rules
The highest-ranked moment owns the screen; the rest wait or
are refused, as the legacy directives did. Fixed triggers,
a sound budget, a priority list and a history.
Attendees: clear, one thing at a time; the final's start
Organisers: little to set up, little to steer.
Cost: M. Risk: low. Fails the design sheets 12–14.
Pizza orders close at 20:00 · Lost and found at the info desk · Demo Game Cup final 21:15 on stage
Cue stack: 1 Countdown · 2 Sting · 3 Bracket reveal · 4 Winner
B · Director's desk: a show you run
A broadcast console: preview and program, a cue stack,
hotkeys and stingers. The operator decides every peak.
Attendees: the finals feel like a stream; between peaks
the screen is whatever the operator left on.
Organisers: a person per peak, or nothing happens.
Crew: a desk job, not a phone job.
Cost: L–XL. Decision 0022 puts the director desk later.
Strongest at the final, weakest at 03:00.
Grand final live on stage · Pizza at the café · Breakfast 08:00
C · Autopilot with a crew remote (recommended)
Rules turn what happens into moments, cues and scenes;
one arbiter shares the screen out by region. The final
takes the hero, the pizza the rail, the ticker keeps going.
Attendees: the room is alive and nothing important waits.
Organisers: presets that work on day one; rules as data.
Crew: announce, spotlight, Peak now, emergency: one tap.
Cost: M–L. Most of the look is already designed (sheets
12–14); the engine is the legacy queue, made regional.
Rules and presets; the crew adds
Storyboards on cue, fired by the run of show
